title: Failure of local extension of semipositive metrics in a smooth projective family
summary: We construct a smooth projective family of rational surfaces and an effective line bundle on its total space that give a negative answer to Păun's metric-extension question. The restricted bundle on the central fibre carries a semipositively curved singular Hermitian metric with analytic and minimal singularities, but this metric admits no semipositive extension to any neighbourhood of the whole fibre, even up to singularity type.
